title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
abstract: arXiv:2611.17966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary component

translated_title: 从图像到定位编辑：手写作文中文语法纠错的现实世界基准
translated_abstract: 中文语法纠错通常被定义为文本到文本的问题。虽然这种形式适用于数字文本，但在现实的K-12教育场景中却存在不足，因为在这些场景中，AI辅助纠错需要直接在作文图像上进行，而这些作文主要是手写的，并且存在许多不规范之处。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了定位式中文语法纠错，这是一个图像到定位编辑的任务，要求系统同时预测纠正内容及其在作文图像上的位置。我们提出了G-CGEC-Eval，一个包含现实世界K-12中文作文图像及细粒度标注的基准。在评估方面，我们改编了目标检测中基于IoU的指标，并提出了一种基于中心距离匹配的更宽容的替代方案。使用该基准，我们在直接单次处理设置下评估了开源和专有的视觉语言模型，以及带有辅助组件的设置……
tldr: 该论文提出了定位式中文语法纠错新任务及首个基于真实K-12手写作文图像的基准G-CGEC-Eval，要求模型同时预测纠错内容及其在图像上的位置，弥合了传统文本级语法纠错与现实教育场景之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces G-CGEC, a new image-to-grounded-edit task that requires models to predict both corrections and their positions on handwritten essay images, along with G-CGEC-Eval, the first real-world benchmark for Chinese grammatical error correction in K-12 handwritten essays.
